cumulativeView.chartHelp: Competency across published assessments. Select a concept to view its percentage and target marker.
cumulativeView.intro: Understand your strengths and what to practise using results from published assessments.
cumulativeView.method: How to read and calculate these results
cumulativeView.methodScore: Competency for each concept = total earned points divided by total possible points from related graded answers, multiplied by 100. This is weighted by points, not a simple average of assessment percentages.
cumulativeView.methodTarget: The target is the benchmark. When assessments have different targets, the cumulative target is weighted by possible points from evidence with a target. No target means that attainment cannot yet be classified.
cumulativeView.methodEvidence: Only published assessments count. Retakes count separately. An answer may assess multiple concepts, so concept points cannot be added into an overall assessment score. Missing evidence is not counted as zero.
cumulativeView.priorityHelp: Start with concepts furthest below their targets. Up to three priorities from published results are shown.
cumulativeView.detailsHint: Open a concept to understand your progress and what to practise next.

cumulativeView.calculationHelp: Total earned points / total possible points from related graded answers.
cumulativeView.noTargetHelp: Graded evidence exists, but no benchmark is set. This is not a below-target result.
cumulativeView.metHelp: Your cumulative competency meets or exceeds the target. Maintain it and try more challenging questions.
cumulativeView.nextImprove: Review {{name}}, practise related questions and compare your responses with available answers and feedback.
